body: Interesting discovery angle: targeted mailing itself is useful, pero mas worth exploring ang digital route. The article says postcard-form recipients can also apply electronically, so this is a good test case for whether Japan is quietly reducing friction in benefits that historically feel paper-heavy. I’d watch one thing: does electronic filing actually improve completion speed/error rates, or digital option lang siya without measured uptake? If JPS later publishes channel usage, that would tell us whether digitization is changing behavior, not just adding another button.

claims.text: The electronic claim route is a useful future indicator of whether administrative digitization is materially reducing benefit-claim friction.
claims.basis: Inference from the article's established availability of electronic filing; no claim is made that uptake or completion has already improved.
